title: Special Episode: The Song That Found Me

sentences.en: I'm Wesley Morris, one of the critics at the New York Times, and we are having a moment.
sentences.zh: 我是韦斯利·莫里斯（Wesley Morris），《纽约时报》的评论员之一，我们正处于一个特殊的时刻。

sentences.en: A large, seismic, unpredictable, ever-changing moment.
sentences.zh: 一个巨大的、震荡的、不可预测的、不断变化的时刻。

sentences.en: And I have just been holding on to all of these images.
sentences.zh: 我一直把所有这些画面都记在心里。

sentences.en: These videos of people, Black men and women on the streets, screaming into people's cameras about how fed up they are with this entire situation.
sentences.zh: 这些视频里，街上的黑人男女对着镜头尖叫，表达他们对整个局势的厌倦。

sentences.en: And everything you know as a Black person in the United States of America, everything you've felt, everything you've been made to feel, you feel it in your heart,
sentences.zh: 作为美国的一名黑人，你所知道的一切、所感受到的一切、被迫感受到的一切，你都能从心底里体会到，

sentences.en: but you've got to persevere.
sentences.zh: 但你必须坚持下去。

sentences.en: You've got to keep going.
sentences.zh: 你必须继续前行。

sentences.en: And when you're having a moment like this, where the ground is shifting beneath your feet in a thousand different ways,
sentences.zh: 当你身处这样一个时刻，脚下的土地以千百种方式发生着位移，

sentences.en: seemingly several times an hour every day for more than two weeks,
sentences.zh: 在两周多的时间里，似乎每天每小时都在发生，

sentences.en: it's useful to try to figure out a way to get your bearings, to moor yourself, so that you don't get lost in all the chaos, and the chaos doesn't swallow you up.
sentences.zh: 试着找到方向、稳住阵脚是很有用的，这样你就不会迷失在混乱中，也不会被混乱吞噬。

sentences.en: And so what happens for me in a moment like this is I turn to art.
sentences.zh: 所以，在这样的时刻，我转向了艺术。

sentences.en: So a couple Sundays ago, I moved forward from my living room into my kitchen.
sentences.zh: 几个星期前的周日，我从客厅走进了厨房。

sentences.en: It's been quite a weekend this particular Sunday.
sentences.zh: 那个周日过得真是不平凡。

sentences.en: I've had protesters on my street coming up and down my block with a great no justice, no peace.
sentences.zh: 街上有抗议者来来回回，高喊着“没有正义，就没有和平”。

sentences.en: And on this particular Sunday, I did what I normally do with my Sundays.
sentences.zh: 而在那个周日，我做了我平时周日会做的事。

sentences.en: I cook, and my companion was going to be music.
sentences.zh: 我做饭，而音乐将是我的伴侣。

sentences.en: So one thing you should know about me is that when it comes to art, I'm a big completioniSt.
sentences.zh: 关于我，你应该知道的一点是，在艺术方面，我是一个彻头彻尾的完美主义者。

sentences.en: That tends to be my mode as a critic.
sentences.zh: 作为一名评论员，这往往是我的工作模式。

sentences.en: I tend to go through periods where I'll read every Philip Roth novel.
sentences.zh: 我倾向于经历一段时期，在那期间我会读完菲利普·罗斯（Philip Roth）的所有小说。

sentences.en: I will watch every Andrei Tarkovsky movie.
sentences.zh: 我会看完安德烈·塔可夫斯基（Andrei Tarkovsky）的所有电影。

sentences.en: And the last couple of weeks, I've been spending my time with one Patti LaBelle.
sentences.zh: 过去几周，我一直在听帕蒂·拉贝尔（Patti LaBelle）的歌。

sentences.en: She's got a number of solo records.
sentences.zh: 她有很多个人专辑。

sentences.en: And I was going through all the solo records when I got to 1985's Patti.
sentences.zh: 当我听完所有个人专辑，听到1985年的《Patti》时，

sentences.en: Patti LaBelle, one of America's greatest singers, one of America's greatest imaginations when it comes to how to sing,
sentences.zh: 帕蒂·拉贝尔，美国最伟大的歌手之一，在演唱方面拥有美国最伟大的想象力之一，

sentences.en: has a voice that could stop traffic.
sentences.zh: 她的嗓音足以让交通停滞。

sentences.en: It could send you into outer space.
sentences.zh: 它能把你送入外太空。

sentences.en: Sometimes it is outer space.
sentences.zh: 有时它本身就是外太空。

sentences.en: It is sometimes just the most beautiful, sustained singing, the notes she can hit, the way she can flatten vowels and then pull them out like taffy.
sentences.zh: 有时那只是最美妙、最持久的歌声，她能唱出的音符，她拉长元音并像拉太妃糖一样将其延展的方式。

sentences.en: And that album closes with a song that I have heard 10,000 times, which is a cover of If You Don't Know Me By Now.
sentences.zh: 那张专辑的最后一首歌我听过一万遍了，那是《If You Don't Know Me By Now》的翻唱版。

sentences.en: It's a classic breakup ballad.
sentences.zh: 这是一首经典的分手情歌。

sentences.en: But I'm standing there in my kitchen, over my sink, listening to it like I've never heard it before in my life.
sentences.zh: 但我站在厨房的水槽边，听着它，感觉就像这辈子第一次听到一样。

sentences.en: And there's a moment in the middle of the song where the band clears a space for her.
sentences.zh: 歌中间有一段，乐队为她留出了空间。

sentences.en: She's talking to the audience through this moment of self-reckoning about how fed up she is.
sentences.zh: 她通过这段自我审视，向观众倾诉她有多么厌倦。

sentences.en: Sometimes you think you're all known about.
sentences.zh: 有时你以为别人完全了解你。

sentences.en: I think it's kind of like your ego gets in the way.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这有点像你的自尊心在作祟。

sentences.en: And you take for granted somebody just knows what you're all about, my dear.
sentences.zh: 你理所当然地认为别人了解你的一切，亲爱的。

sentences.en: And they just don't.
sentences.zh: 但他们根本不了解。

sentences.en: She is walking us through what it's like to be misunderstood, underappreciated, in the bargain and contract of a relationship.
sentences.zh: 她正在引导我们感受在一段关系的契约中，被误解、被低估是什么滋味。

sentences.en: You break your back, you break your legs, and you break your face.
sentences.zh: 你累断了背，跑断了腿，丢尽了脸。

sentences.en: Trying to make these people know you're in line.
sentences.zh: 试图让这些人明白你的立场。

sentences.en: But somehow, they just don't want to try to.
sentences.zh: 但不知为何，他们就是不想尝试去理解。

sentences.en: You know, I'm me, and you're you, and we've been together.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我是我，你是你，我们在一起很久了。

sentences.en: We've been doing this for a long time.
sentences.zh: 我们在一起这么长时间了。

sentences.en: And I can't believe after all this time, you still haven't figured out who I am, what I am, what I'm about, what I believe.
sentences.zh: 我简直不敢相信，过了这么久，你还是没弄明白我是谁、我是什么样的人、我在乎什么、我信仰什么。

sentences.en: So you say to yourself, is it something I said?
sentences.zh: 所以你问自己，是我说了什么吗？

sentences.en: Is it something I done?
sentences.zh: 是我做了什么吗？

sentences.en: And after Patti LaBelle has walked everybody through this moment where she is regarding herself in a mirror, is how I imagine it.
sentences.zh: 在帕蒂·拉贝尔引导大家经历这一刻时，我想象她正对着镜子审视自己。

sentences.en: She just says,
sentences.zh: 她只是说，

sentences.en: Self, is it worth it?
sentences.zh: 自己啊，这值得吗？

sentences.en: Am I going to do this for 10 more years?
sentences.zh: 我还要再这样过十年吗？

sentences.en: Am I going to keep staying in this relationship and hoping that things get better?
sentences.zh: 我还要继续维持这段关系，并希望情况好转吗？

sentences.en: Because I'm not going to change.
sentences.zh: 因为我不会改变。

sentences.en: So unless you change, and you haven't changed yet, you keep acting like you just met me.
sentences.zh: 所以除非你改变，而你还没变，你还是表现得像刚认识我一样。

sentences.en: And if you don't know what the deal is at this point, I don't know what to tell you.
sentences.zh: 如果你到现在还不明白是怎么回事，我不知道该对你说什么了。

sentences.en: And then she just lets out this.
sentences.zh: 然后她就发出了这一声。

sentences.en: And all of the, I can only just say stuff, that I have been carrying around all these years,
sentences.zh: 所有那些，我只能说是“东西”，我多年来一直背负着的，

sentences.en: all these decades, I wonder if an epidemiologist would say I was born with it.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，我不知道流行病学家会不会说我是天生就带着这些。

sentences.en: And every once in a while, something reaches it, and it squeezes it, and it squeezes it, and then it pops.
sentences.zh: 每隔一段时间，有什么东西触碰到了它，挤压它，挤压它，然后它就爆发了。

sentences.en: And Patti LaBelle just popped that thing for me in this moment.
sentences.zh: 而帕蒂·拉贝尔在那一刻为我引爆了它。

sentences.en: And I just wept.
sentences.zh: 我禁不住泪流满面。

sentences.en: It is a rock through a window.
sentences.zh: 它就像砸向窗户的石头。

sentences.en: It is the burning down of a house.
sentences.zh: 它就像烧毁的房子。

sentences.en: It's an anger that I feel that I couldn't express the way she expresses it.
sentences.zh: 那是一种我无法像她那样表达出来的愤怒。

sentences.en: And my brain went right to that man's knee on George Floyd's neck.
sentences.zh: 我的大脑立刻浮现出那个男人跪在乔治·弗洛伊德（George Floyd）脖子上的画面。

sentences.en: It went to every other African-American who has died at the hands of a police officer, or really of anybody wrongfully, and how we sit with that.
sentences.zh: 它浮现出每一个死于警察之手，或者死于任何不义之手的非裔美国人，以及我们是如何面对这一切的。

sentences.en: Each one of those deaths, even though that person is a total stranger to us,
sentences.zh: 每一次死亡，即使那个人对我们来说完全陌生，

sentences.en: we carry it with us.
sentences.zh: 我们都铭记在心。

sentences.en: But I knew that this moment was the last straw for me.
sentences.zh: 但我知道，这一刻对我来说是压死骆驼的最后一根稻草。

sentences.en: And I suspect that this moment of Nina Pop being killed, and Breonna Taylor being killed, and Ahmaud Arbery being killed, and George Floyd being killed,
sentences.zh: 我怀疑尼娜·波普（Nina Pop）、布伦娜·泰勒（Breonna Taylor）、艾哈迈德·阿贝里（Ahmaud Arbery）和乔治·弗洛伊德的遇害，

sentences.en: this is it, because there's a lot of stuff coursing through a lot of people in this country.
sentences.zh: 就是这样了，因为这个国家的许多人心中正涌动着许多情绪。

sentences.en: And they've had it.
sentences.zh: 他们受够了。

sentences.en: This is it.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: This is the dam breaking, and I don't know if there's anything that the racists of this country can do to redam what is broke.
sentences.zh: 大坝决堤了，我不知道这个国家的种族主义者还能做什么来修补这破碎的一切。

sentences.en: So this was essentially based on a piece of writing that I did.
sentences.zh: 所以这基本上是基于我写的一篇文章。

sentences.en: And a few days after it published, my phone rang.
sentences.zh: 文章发表几天后，我的电话响了。

sentences.en: And it was a Philadelphia number.
sentences.zh: 是一个费城的号码。

sentences.en: I'm from Philadelphia.
sentences.zh: 我来自费城。

sentences.en: So in my thinking, when I see those numbers, I think, could it be my cousin Paulette?
sentences.zh: 所以我在想，当我看到这些号码时，我想，会是我表姐波莱特（Paulette）吗？

sentences.en: Could it be Bumsy?
sentences.zh: 会是邦西（Bumsy）吗？

sentences.en: Could it be one of my sister's many girlfriends who likes to call me every once in a while, but their numbers change too?
sentences.zh: 会是我姐姐的那些女朋友之一吗？她们偶尔也喜欢给我打电话，但她们的号码也换了？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: It could have been anybody.
sentences.zh: 可能是任何人。

sentences.en: So I take the call, and it was someone who introduced himself as Eddie.
sentences.zh: 所以我接了电话，对方自称是埃迪（Eddie）。

sentences.en: And he says, Wesley Morris,
sentences.zh: 他说，韦斯利·莫里斯，

sentences.en: I have Miss Patti LaBelle here waiting to speak to you.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂·拉贝尔女士在这儿等着和你说话。

sentences.en: And so I'm like, okay, sure.
sentences.zh: 所以我说，好的，没问题。

sentences.en: I'm taking the call.
sentences.zh: 我接这个电话。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes, by all means.
sentences.zh: 是的，当然。

sentences.en: I am taking this call.
sentences.zh: 我一定要接这个电话。

sentences.en: And she had basically reached out to tell me that she was so appreciative of what I'd written.
sentences.zh: 她基本上是特意打来告诉我，她非常欣赏我写的东西。

sentences.en: We talked for about 11 minutes, and she told me more things in 11 minutes than I think most people get done in 11 hours of talking.
sentences.zh: 我们聊了大约11分钟，我觉得她在11分钟里告诉我的事情，比大多数人聊11个小时还要多。

sentences.en: She was so warm and effusive, and in my being starstruck, I realized when we got off the phone that I actually did have a couple of questions that I wanted to ask her.
sentences.zh: 她非常热情洋溢，而在我被偶像震撼的同时，挂断电话后我意识到，我其实还有几个问题想问她。

sentences.en: So the other day, in the late afternoon, I sat down in my living room, and I called her back.
sentences.zh: 所以前几天傍晚，我坐在客厅里，给她回了电话。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 喂。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 喂。

sentences.en: Hey.
sentences.zh: 嘿。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: As far as I'm concerned, it's morning.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，现在就是早上。

sentences.en: Well, good morning to you, Miss Patti LaBelle.
sentences.zh: 好吧，早上好，帕蒂·拉贝尔女士。

sentences.en: I'm pretty good.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: How are you doing?
sentences.zh: 你怎么样？

sentences.en: I cannot complain.
sentences.zh: 我没什么可抱怨的。

sentences.en: I woke up this morning.
sentences.zh: 我今天早上醒来了。

sentences.en: Amen.
sentences.zh: 阿门。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: That was the main thing, honey.
sentences.zh: 那才是最重要的，亲爱的。

sentences.en: So how are you doing?
sentences.zh: 那你怎么样？

sentences.en: What are you doing with your time right now?
sentences.zh: 你现在怎么打发时间？

sentences.en: How are you spending it?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么度过的？

sentences.en: You know how I'm spending my time.
sentences.zh: 你知道我是怎么打发时间的。

sentences.en: Can I cook?
sentences.zh: 我可以做饭吗？

sentences.en: Can I cook?
sentences.zh: 我可以做饭吗？

sentences.en: So that's what I've been doing for the last four months, you know, and loving it.
sentences.zh: 这就是我过去四个月一直在做的事，你知道，而且我很喜欢。

sentences.en: I love to cook for everybody.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢为大家做饭。

sentences.en: So I've been cooking.
sentences.zh: 所以我一直在做饭。

sentences.en: I've been watching my grandkids swim, you know, because I can't swim.
sentences.zh: 我一直在看我的孙辈们游泳，你知道，因为我不会游泳。

sentences.en: So they get out there.
sentences.zh: 所以他们就在外面游。

sentences.en: We'll have something on the grill, social distancing.
sentences.zh: 我们会在烤架上弄点吃的，保持社交距离。

sentences.en: So that's what I've been doing, arranging flowers, cooking, meditating, and praying.
sentences.zh: 这就是我一直在做的事，插花、做饭、冥想和祈祷。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Well, you know, what I'm wondering is, what brings you comfort in a moment like this?
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，我想知道的是，在这样的时刻，什么能给你带来安慰？

sentences.en: I mean, there's the pandemic on the one hand.
sentences.zh: 我是说，一方面有疫情。

sentences.en: There are these protests.
sentences.zh: 还有这些抗议活动。

sentences.en: The riots, protesting.
sentences.zh: 骚乱，抗议。

sentences.en: What brings me peace.
sentences.zh: 什么能给我带来平静。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Things like billions of marches all over the world, marching for something that I'm feeling so strong on that's going to happen, a change.
sentences.zh: 像全世界数十亿人的游行，为了我强烈感受到的即将发生的事情——变革——而游行。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And it's going to be a positive change because all these people in spare their lives, they're marching and COVID.
sentences.zh: 这将是一个积极的变革，因为所有这些人不顾生命危险，在新冠疫情中游行。

sentences.en: They said, I'd rather die marching for something so positive.
sentences.zh: 他们说，我宁愿为了如此积极的事情而死在游行中。

sentences.en: That's what I get.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的收获。

sentences.en: My comfort is being here with my little puppy watching, watching the TV and watching things, just watching everything and saying, oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 我的安慰就是和我的小狗待在一起，看着电视，看着各种事情，只是看着一切，然后说，哦，天哪。

sentences.en: Is there music, like when you've been feeling, I mean, I don't know how down you get.
sentences.zh: 有没有什么音乐，比如当你感到……我是说，我不知道你会多沮丧。

sentences.en: I don't know how, you know, bluesy you start to feel.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你，你知道，会有多忧郁。

sentences.en: But when you get in those places, if you do, what music gets you out or what music helps you through it?
sentences.zh: 但当你陷入那种境地时，如果真的陷入了，什么音乐能让你走出来，或者什么音乐能帮你度过难关？

sentences.en: Well, there are so many types of music that helps me through it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有很多种音乐能帮我度过难关。

sentences.en: I mean, I love California love.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我喜欢《California Love》。

sentences.en: I love that.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢那首歌。

sentences.en: I love 50 Cent.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢50 Cent。

sentences.en: I love Bob Dylan.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢鲍勃·迪伦（Bob Dylan）。

sentences.en: The answer is blowing in the wind.
sentences.zh: 《答案在风中飘荡》（The answer is blowing in the wind）。

sentences.en: A change is going to come.
sentences.zh: 《变革终将到来》（A change is going to come）。

sentences.en: I performed that like three weeks ago in Philadelphia for a Philly shout out for the COVID.
sentences.zh: 我大约三周前在费城为新冠疫情的费城呐喊活动表演过那首歌。

sentences.en: And I sang a change is going to come.
sentences.zh: 我唱了《变革终将到来》。

sentences.en: You know, I'm struggling being the black girl who sang If You Ask Me To.
sentences.zh: 你知道，作为一个唱过《If You Ask Me To》的黑人女孩，我感到很挣扎。

sentences.en: But mine is not accepted the way my girlfriend's is, you know?
sentences.zh: 但我的版本不像我女朋友唱的那样被接受，你知道吗？

sentences.en: You know, you're talking about your great version, If You Ask Me To, that great song.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你在说你那个伟大的版本，《If You Ask Me To》，那首伟大的歌。

sentences.en: And Celine Dion sings it, and it's a bigger hit.
sentences.zh: 席琳·迪翁（Celine Dion）唱了它，结果它成了更大的热门。

sentences.en: And it's like that in all parts of my life.
sentences.zh: 我生活中的方方面面都是这样。

sentences.en: I have to work seen to be seen.
sentences.zh: 我必须努力工作才能被看见。

sentences.en: Not even listen to.
sentences.zh: 甚至不是被倾听。

sentences.en: First, you got to see you and see if they want to see that black face and listen to that black face music.
sentences.zh: 首先，你得先被看见，看看他们是否愿意看那张黑人的脸，听那黑人的音乐。

sentences.en: You know, and then when they do, they compare.
sentences.zh: 你知道，等他们真的看了，他们又会去比较。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And they take the other one instead of mine.
sentences.zh: 然后他们选了别人，而不是我。

sentences.en: And of course, that hurts.
sentences.zh: 当然，这很伤人。

sentences.en: And she's one of my best friends.
sentences.zh: 而她还是我最好的朋友之一。

sentences.en: But, you know, it hurts.
sentences.zh: 但你知道，这真的很伤人。

sentences.en: So it's a whole bunch of stuff, honey.
sentences.zh: 所以这真的是一言难尽，亲爱的。

sentences.en: I know, I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道，我知道。

sentences.en: On and on.
sentences.zh: 没完没了。

sentences.en: I can't take it, but I take it.
sentences.zh: 我受不了，但我还是忍了。

sentences.en: And I always smile.
sentences.zh: 而且我总是面带微笑。

sentences.en: What was it about this Gamble and Huff song, If You Don't Know Me By Now?
sentences.zh: 这首甘布尔和哈夫（Gamble and Huff）的歌《If You Don't Know Me By Now》有什么特别之处吗？

sentences.en: If You Don't Know Me?
sentences.zh: 如果你不了解我呢？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: What made you want to sing that?
sentences.zh: 是什么让你想唱这首歌？

sentences.en: Well, because Kenny and Leon, they're some of my better friends.
sentences.zh: 嗯，因为肯尼（Kenny）和里昂（Leon）是我比较好的朋友。

sentences.en: And after I heard the song by Teddy, I think Kenny said, you need to do this song or something.
sentences.zh: 听了泰迪（Teddy）唱的版本后，我想肯尼说，你应该唱这首歌之类的。

sentences.en: Yeah, Teddy Pendergrass, the great Teddy Pendergrass.
sentences.zh: 没错，泰迪·潘德格拉斯（Teddy Pendergrass），伟大的泰迪·潘德格拉斯。

sentences.en: Uh-huh.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And Kenny Gamble said, girlfriend, you have to do this song.
sentences.zh: 肯尼·甘布尔（Kenny Gamble）说，亲爱的，你一定要唱这首歌。

sentences.en: And I, of course, listened to it before.
sentences.zh: 当然，我之前也听过。

sentences.en: I said, I can record this song.
sentences.zh: 我说，我可以录这首歌。

sentences.en: And, of course, I did.
sentences.zh: 当然，我录了。

sentences.en: Because that's the song that I would kick my pumps off and back in the day, roll on the floor.
sentences.zh: 因为那是我以前会踢掉高跟鞋，在地上打滚的那种歌。

sentences.en: I can't roll on that floor now.
sentences.zh: 我现在可没法在地上打滚了。

sentences.en: But I could still kick the pumps off, you know, and do that.
sentences.zh: 但我还是能踢掉高跟鞋，你知道，做那个动作。

sentences.en: But that's one of those songs that I had to do.
sentences.zh: 但这确实是我必须唱的歌之一。

sentences.en: And I was doing a live in D.C.
sentences.zh: 当时我正在华盛顿特区演出。

sentences.en: at Constitution Hall.
sentences.zh: 在宪法大厅。

sentences.en: And my voice was so bad, I saw a specialiSt.
sentences.zh: 我的嗓子太糟糕了，我去看了一位专家。

sentences.en: And he said, Ms. LaBelle, don't sing or you'll never sing again.
sentences.zh: 他说，拉贝尔女士（Ms. LaBelle），别唱歌了，否则你以后再也唱不了了。

sentences.en: And I said, I can't sing no more.
sentences.zh: 我说，我没法再唱了。

sentences.en: I'm going to run away because my voice is gone.
sentences.zh: 我要逃跑，因为我的嗓子毁了。

sentences.en: And I can't face that audience tonight, you know, without singing.
sentences.zh: 我没法在今晚面对那些观众，你知道，在没法唱歌的情况下。

sentences.en: So I ran away from the hotel.
sentences.zh: 所以我从酒店逃跑了。

sentences.en: I had gone right next door to a gas station from the Watergate Hotel.
sentences.zh: 我直接去了水门酒店隔壁的加油站。

sentences.en: So I was in there for, like, about an hour, knowing they were looking for me.
sentences.zh: 我在那儿待了大约一个小时，我知道他们肯定在找我。

sentences.en: So you're at a gas station for an hour?
sentences.zh: 所以你在加油站待了一个小时？

sentences.en: Just nobody walked by?
sentences.zh: 就没人走过吗？

sentences.en: I was at a gas station for an hour.
sentences.zh: 我在加油站待了一个小时。

sentences.en: Nobody knew who I was.
sentences.zh: 没人认出我是谁。

sentences.en: I wasn't done up.
sentences.zh: 我没化妆。

sentences.en: I didn't look like me.
sentences.zh: 看起来不像我本人。

sentences.en: I was in the gas station just hiding from the world.
sentences.zh: 我躲在加油站里，避开这个世界。

sentences.en: And nobody could care less who I was because they didn't know.
sentences.zh: 没人关心我是谁，因为他们根本不知道。

sentences.en: But my husband and the posse, honey, they were looking for me.
sentences.zh: 但我丈夫和那帮人，亲爱的，他们一直在找我。

sentences.en: And I said, it's not.
sentences.zh: 我说，不行。

sentences.en: Plus, I was hungry.
sentences.zh: 而且，我饿了。

sentences.en: I said, let me get out this gas station and eat these chips.
sentences.zh: 我说，让我离开这个加油站，去吃这些薯片吧。

sentences.en: I didn't have money, so I would have to steal a bag of chips if I wanted to eat.
sentences.zh: 我没带钱，如果我想吃，就得偷一袋薯片。

sentences.en: So I did want to eat.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实想吃东西。

sentences.en: And I did want to please the audience.
sentences.zh: 我也确实想取悦观众。

sentences.en: And I did want to show up.
sentences.zh: 我也确实想出席。

sentences.en: And that's the night that I did, if you don't know me by now, live.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，我现场演唱了《If You Don't Know Me By Now》。

sentences.en: And I made up that.
sentences.zh: 那是我临时发挥的。

sentences.en: We were singing.
sentences.zh: 我们在唱歌。

sentences.en: I was so mad at what?
sentences.zh: 我当时那么生气，是因为什么？

sentences.en: I was mad at myself for not having the voice I wanted.
sentences.zh: 我生自己的气，因为我没有达到我想要的嗓音状态。

sentences.en: But the voice sounds okay on the recording, you know.
sentences.zh: 但录音里的声音听起来还不错，你知道。

sentences.en: It sounds amazing.
sentences.zh: 听起来棒极了。

sentences.en: Are you kidding?
sentences.zh: 你在开玩笑吗？

sentences.en: I know you like it, baby.
sentences.zh: 我知道你喜欢它，宝贝。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: You know, that was a runaway night in my life.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那是我生命中逃跑的一晚。

sentences.en: Ran away.
sentences.zh: 逃跑了。

sentences.en: But came back and we did a great show at Constitution Hall.
sentences.zh: 但后来又回来了，我们在宪法大厅做了一场精彩的演出。

sentences.en: Well, I got to say that I'm glad that you changed your mind and got yourself to the Constitution.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我得说，很高兴你改变了主意，去了宪法大厅。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: I am, too.
sentences.zh: 我也是。

sentences.en: I'm so happy I did.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴我去了。

sentences.en: But, you know, fear sometimes can lead you in the wrong place.
sentences.zh: 但你知道，恐惧有时会把你带向错误的地方。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Fear is a fighter.
sentences.zh: 恐惧是个斗士。

sentences.en: And if you let fear win, then you're punk.
sentences.zh: 如果你让恐惧获胜，那你就是个懦夫。

sentences.en: And it ain't no punking, Patty.
sentences.zh: 而我才不是懦夫，帕蒂（Patty）。

sentences.en: Mm-mm.
sentences.zh: 嗯嗯。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: So the little punk girl went out there and sang her song.
sentences.zh: 所以那个小懦夫还是走上台唱了她的歌。

sentences.en: Oh, my goodness.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: But I got the pleasure of that audience.
sentences.zh: 但我得到了观众的喜爱。

sentences.en: And you can hear them.
sentences.zh: 你可以听到他们的声音。

sentences.en: They are really.
sentences.zh: 他们真的是。

sentences.en: Oh, God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: They are responding to you.
sentences.zh: 他们在回应你。

sentences.en: Uh-huh.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Big time.
sentences.zh: 非常热烈。

sentences.en: It was so beautiful.
sentences.zh: 那真是太美好了。

sentences.en: You like me or you love me or you hate me.
sentences.zh: 你喜欢我，或者爱我，或者恨我。

sentences.en: And I've been getting a lot of love.
sentences.zh: 而我一直感受到很多爱。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Well, I hope you feel it right now.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我希望你现在也能感受到。

sentences.en: I do, honey.
sentences.zh: 我感受到了，亲爱的。

sentences.en: From you.
sentences.zh: 来自你的爱。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Because when I read that article, I said, this man must be my husband.
sentences.zh: 因为当我读到那篇文章时，我说，这个男人一定是我丈夫。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: This little stuff.
sentences.zh: 这些小事。

sentences.en: I promise you.
sentences.zh: 我向你保证。

sentences.en: I said, who paid him?
sentences.zh: 我说，谁付钱给他了？

sentences.en: I said, okay.
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧。

sentences.en: But I'll just say in closing, before I let you go, that, like, you know, I listen to you all the time.
sentences.zh: 但在结束之前，在你走之前，我想说，你知道，我一直都在听你的歌。

sentences.en: You're a part of my music diet.
sentences.zh: 你是我的音乐食粮的一部分。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: But I feel like that moment in the kitchen that I had.
sentences.zh: 但我感觉就像我在厨房里的那一刻。

sentences.en: I mean, I wasn't looking for, like, a release.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我并不是在寻找一种释放。

sentences.en: I wasn't looking for catharsis.
sentences.zh: 我并不是在寻找宣泄。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: I was just listening to you.
sentences.zh: 我只是在听你唱歌。

sentences.en: And I feel like that song found me.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那首歌找到了我。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 噢。

sentences.en: That's very interesting.
sentences.zh: 这太有趣了。

sentences.en: It found you.
sentences.zh: 它找到了你。

sentences.en: I'm going to play it when I hang up.
sentences.zh: 我挂了电话就要去听。

sentences.en: Because I don't listen to music, especially my music.
sentences.zh: 因为我不怎么听音乐，尤其是我的音乐。

sentences.en: Because I don't listen to my music, but I'm going to listen to that when I hang up.
sentences.zh: 因为我不听自己的歌，但我挂了电话会去听那首。

sentences.en: You should.
sentences.zh: 你应该听听。

sentences.en: The person singing it is incredibly talented.
sentences.zh: 唱歌的那个人非常有才华。

sentences.en: Oh, thank you, darling.
sentences.zh: 噢，谢谢你，亲爱的。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: I love the way you love me.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢你爱我的方式。

sentences.en: Well, I appreciate you.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我很感激你。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: It's so nice talking to you.
sentences.zh: 和你聊天真愉快。

sentences.en: It's a pleasure talking to you.
sentences.zh: 和你聊天也是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: Okay, honey.
sentences.zh: 好的，亲爱的。

sentences.en: Be safe.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: You be safe.
sentences.zh: 你也保重。

sentences.en: And have fun in your pool.
sentences.zh: 在泳池里玩得开心。

sentences.en: Yeah, right.
sentences.zh: 是啊，没错。

sentences.en: Watching them swim.
sentences.zh: 看着他们游泳。

sentences.en: I can't swim.
sentences.zh: 我不会游泳。

sentences.zh: 我走到那儿，在按摩浴缸那块儿踢踢腿。

sentences.en: Miss Patty, that's just as good.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂女士，那也一样好。

sentences.en: I know it is.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.zh: 我在锻炼身体。
